title: How does the NFL value change longitudinally after a change or start of disease modifying treatment?
summary: Das Ziel unserer Studie ist, den zeitlichen Verlauf des Biomarkers Neurofilament unter Einwirkung immunmodulatorischer Therapien bei Menschen mit Multipler Sklerose zu untersuchen. Zusätzlich prüfen wir, ob Neurofilament den klinischen Verlauf und das Therapieansprechen vorhersagen kann.

interventions.name:
People with multiple sclerosis (pwMS) who start a new disease-modifying treatment (DMT) or switching from one to another. 
We plan to measure serum neurofilament (sNfl) in the setting of routine laboratory controls.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Clinically-isolated syndrome or multiple sclerosis according to current McDonald criteria.
Exclusion criteria:
- Factors that contraindicate follow-up examinations as part of the study, e.g. florid alcohol abuse,
- Patient not capable of giving consent
